review_summary: Students consistently describe Gijs Peters as a calm, patient, friendly instructor who explains clearly, adapts to the learner's pace, helps nervous/insecure students gain confidence, and is flexible with timing and pickup; many report passing on the first attempt. All available reviews are Google 5-star with no negative feedback, but they come from a single platform and are unverified.
